title: Infraclavicular or Supraclavicular Brachial Plexus Blocks for Elbow Surgery
brief_summary: This study compares the infraclavicular approach to supraclavicular approach of brachial plexus block for elbow surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients scheduled for ambulatory elbow surgery under block
* ASA 1-3

Exclusion Criteria:

* Narcotic dependent
* Severe systemic illness
* Refusal of block
* localized infection
